text:
samantha: Heads up — Oracle Marketplace PO from Zephyr Systems stalled. Procurement says PO signer needs to be the local Oracle channel partner entity and our marketplace listing shows 'Redwood Inc.' as seller. They won't accept the PO until Channel Partner ID and remit-to entity match. Any quick fixes?

kate-sales: Ugh. Is this the APAC account? I saw something similar last quarter with an AWS reseller. Zephyr's procurement sent a screenshot — they want 'LocalSeller: Redwood APAC Pte Ltd' and CPID in the PO header. We don't have that entity in the Oracle listing.

vincent-partnerops: Oracle's marketplace model is pretty strict on CPID. In theory we can add a reseller alias, but on Oracle that often requires TAM intervention. I'll ping the TAM but their sync is usually 48-72h.

jordan-legal: We can prepare a short marketplace addendum + attestation that lets us accept POs referencing an authorized reseller entity. Redline note: must avoid adding new indemnities or payment terms. Proposed clause: "Marketplace Seller may accept purchase orders referencing an authorized reseller entity without substantive amendment to the Master Agreement."

miguel-finance: From Finance: we can accept a PO only if remit-to and tax ID match a vendor record. Options: (1) create a vendor alias (needs legal + vendor setup, ~3-5 business days) (2) ask buyer to self-bill (rare) (3) invoice directly outside the marketplace and cut a one-off reconciliation — risky for marketplace revenue recognition.

marketplace-bot: Oracle Marketplace ticket ORC-8921 created (https://oracle.ticket/ORC-8921). Oracle ETA: 48-72 hrs for channel partner ID sync.

samantha: Timeline matters — Zephyr needs contract signed by Friday to hit quarter. Can we do an interim workaround: sign the attestation + create vendor alias and provide proof to procurement?

kate-sales: I'll ask Zephyr if they can accept a PO that references 'Redwood Inc. (dba Redwood APAC)' plus a signed attestation email from us. That might buy a week.

jordan-legal: Drafting the attestation and a trimmed addendum now. @miguel-finance: what exact remit/tax fields do you need in the attestation for Finance to accept? Also who is authorized to sign for the APAC entity?

miguel-finance: We need exact remit address, full legal name of receiving entity, and the tax/registration ID. Bank account details if the APAC entity will accept funds directly. If not, we need an instruct-to-pay plan to the US entity and a tax impact note.

vincent-partnerops: Oracle TAM (Priya) says if we provide CPID + signed attestation she can force the partner sync; she'll escalate but still ~48h. If Oracle can't sync in that window we need fallback.

kate-sales: Zephyr replies: "We can accept an attestation if Redwood's legal signs and Oracle shows CPID or vendor alias on the PO."

samantha: Action items: Jordan — finalize attestation + addendum today. Vincent — escalate to Oracle TAM in parallel. Miguel — confirm finance acceptance criteria and whether instruct-to-pay is possible. I'll coordinate with Zephyr procurement. :pray:

miguel-finance: Confirmed — if attestation + CPID visible in Oracle UI we can route the PO. If not, we'll need exec approval to process outside marketplace.

marketplace-bot: Ticket ORC-8921 updated -> priority P1. Assigned to TAM Priya K.

vincent-partnerops: Noted. If Oracle can't sync within 48h fallback is direct invoice outside marketplace which will need Sales leadership sign-off for revenue/booking changes.

samantha: Thanks team. Tagging @ceo for visibility. I'll post progress updates here.
